lines.text: We have historical maintenance records for three hundred commercial elevators.
Our data team regularly handles elevator service log migrations.
We can handle the CSV migration within thirty days of contract signature.
Do you have emergency pager integrations for trapped passengers?
We could explore automated pager integrations down the road with product.
What is the overall target date for the initial rollout?
We target full go-live within forty-five days of signing the agreement.
Understood. We will provide our equipment inventory file by the fifteenth.
